facts.fact: Law no. 2021-014 on electronic payment services and instruments was passed by the National Assembly and published in the Journal Officiel no. 1490 of 30 July 2021; it regulates payment service providers and e-money issuers operating in Mauritania (event date is the Official Gazette publication, as the excerpt gives no promulgation date).
facts.system: Loi n° 2021-014 relative aux services et moyens de paiement électronique
